title: Corrosion of Metals and alloys - classification of corrosivity of atmosphere
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies key factors in the atmospheric corrosion of metals and alloys, classifies categories for time of wetness and pollution by SO2 and airborne salinity and defines corrosivity categories on the basis of corrosion classification data. 1.2 The classification given in this standard can be used directly to evaluate the corrosivity of atmospheres for metals and alloys under known conditions of time of wetness and pollution by SO2 and/or airborne chlorides within classified ranges. 1.2.1 This standard does not characterize the corrosivity of specific service atmospheres, for example, the atmospheres of chemical or metallurgical industries because the pollution and time of wetness characterization of these environments cannot be generalized. 1.2.2 The classified pollution and corrosivity categories can be directly used for technical and economical analysis of corrosion damage and for rational choice of protection measures. 1.3 Annex A represents the technical content of this standard in form» easy to survey.
